jobs.title: AI Product Manager (Demo)
jobs.description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

Celonis Demo Engineering is the creative and technical engine of our Go-To-Market strategy. We are embarking on a high-stakes mission to build the Next-Gen Demo Factory - a world where AI agents and LLMs handle the heavy lifting of demo creation.

This transformation is critical not only to maintain our lead in Process Intelligence but to ensure Celonis wins the Enterprise AI market. By feeding operational business context to AI, we enable the world’s largest companies to industrialize AI and unlock real ROI. You will co-lead this transformation within the team, architecting agentic systems and building tools that turn customer business problems into compelling demos for 1,000+ GTM colleagues inside and outside Celonis.

The work you’ll do:

- Architect Agentic Demo Builds: Lead the shift toward "Prompt-to-Demo" workflows, from Atlas mockups to in-product demos with Apollo. You will build and continuously improve AI agents to automate the generation of data stories, UI screens, and configurations from simple business requirements.

- Elevate Field Delivery & Enablement: Create "Self-Service" agentic tools that allow Sales Reps and Solution Engineers to "chat" with a demo environment. These agents will generate custom talk-tracks, executive summaries, and personalized pitch decks on demand, ensuring every pitch is "Gold Standard." . Drive adoption through enablement and iterate based on user feedback.

- Master the AI Demo Lifecycle: Own the end-to-end development**, release, and ongoing improvement** of our most strategic AI demo tools and assets. This includes identifying the highest-impact demo opportunities across pre-sales , prioritizing features, building solutions, and leading technical configuration and QA . Work with Product and engineering partners to evolve these tools alongside the Celonis platform.

- Scale Through Automation: Identify repetitive manual tasks in the demo lifecycle—from data cleaning to screen setup—and build AI-driven tools/orchestrations to reduce manual effort and demo creation time .

- Creative AI Storytelling: Use generative tools to translate complex data into visionary C-level narratives, ensuring our automated assets maintain a human-centric, high-impact quality.

The qualifications you need:

- The Builder DNA: You are a natural "problem solver through automation." You have hands-on experience building tools that help others succeed and a preference for building a scalable "generator" over manually fixing a single screen.

- 1.5+ Years of Experience: Professional experience in Value Engineering, Applied AI, Solution Engineering, Demo Engineering, Technical Consulting, or a similar "Product-adjacent" role.

- Technical Baseline: A hunger to learn new technologies and hands-on proficiency in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or a comparable programming language . You should be comfortable working with data, integrating AI models and APIs, and debugging the tools you build .

- Strategic Storyteller: The ability to identify high-impact use cases and take complex technical capabilities and turn them into a simple, value-driven business story for an executive audience.

- High Learning Velocity: The AI landscape moves fast; you must be excited to constantly experiment with new models, frameworks, and prompting techniques.

Nice to Have (Big Plus):

- Cloud Platforms & Workflows: Experience building cloud-based workflows or applications using services such as Microsoft Azure and Azure Blob Storage.

- Software Development & Delivery: Experience with GitHub, version control, deployment workflows, and maintaining web applications used by others.

- Web Applications & UI/UX: Experience with frontend development and UI/UX design, turning complex AI capabilities into intuitive web applications.

- Celonis & Process Expertise: Experience with the Celonis platform, in-product applications

What Celonis can offer you:

- Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.

- Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.

- Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.

- Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.

- Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.

- Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.

- Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.

- Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

The team

As part of the Product Management organization, we develop the platform that drives the next generation of enterprise intelligence and process improvement. We are a team of product enthusiasts who like to push the boundaries of the status quo and drive the product forward with innovative thinking.

The Data Foundation & Networks team is dedicated to revolutionizing how businesses connect and collaborate. Our mission is to create a seamless, efficient ecosystem that streamlines processes for our clients. Because data integration is the bedrock of our platform, our team focuses on building the pipelines that allow different enterprise ecosystems to securely ingest, manage, and share critical data at scale.

The role

We are seeking an experienced Associate Principal Product Manager to lead our Networks initiative. This exciting solution aims to transform how businesses interact with their partners, suppliers, and customers by enabling them to share data securely and efficiently.

You will be responsible for defining the platform vision and strategy for our Networks product. To succeed, you need a deep technical DNA combined with expertise in data sharing and business networks. You will transform technical complexity into seamless "plug-and-play" data-sharing experiences for the world’s largest enterprises leveraging Celonis Intelligence.

The work you'll do

- Define the vision, build, and execute the roadmap for our Networks product aligned with broader business goals.

- Partner closely with engineering to optimize ingestion capabilities so network participants can share massive enterprise datasets smoothly.

- Work directly with customers, engineering teams, and the go-to-market organization to deeply understand the data-sharing needs of network participants.

- Leverage your domain expertise in modern ETL/ELT landscapes to identify key product features, integration points, and collaborative use cases.

- Serve as the subject matter expert for Networks, championing its data-sharing features, security protocols, and value proposition both internally and externally.

- Establish partnerships with key players in the network ecosystem to foster innovation, navigate complex third-party data architectures, and drive platform adoption.

- Monitor key product metrics and performance indicators, evaluating feature adoption and data throughput to inform decision-making and continuous improvement.

The qualifications you need

- 6+ years in product management, with at least 3 years focused on enterprise software solutions.

- Strong understanding of data ingestion patterns and protocols.

- Demonstrable aptitude for learning and understanding complex business processes and challenges.

- Ability to hold your own in architectural discussions with Engineering while simplifying those concepts for C-level executives.

- Proven track record of crafting vision and strategy for complex enterprise software products and successfully launching them to market.

- Strong analytical skills with a love for using data to optimize system performance and drive actionable product decisions.

- Exceptional ability to influence without authority and tell a compelling story about the "why" behind the "what."

Nice to have

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Business to connect technical network performance to broad enterprise ROI.

- Familiarity or experience with modern data management tools like Databricks, or Snowflake.

- Direct experience with supply chain platforms, major cloud ecosystems, and navigating complex ERP architectures.

The Team:

The Celonis Business Apps IT team brings together product managers and data engineers to build best-in-class, composable solutions for enterprise system transformation. In close alignment with the Celonis and Oracle go-to-market partnership, this team develops purpose-built solutions for Oracle source systems, including Oracle E-Business Suite, JD Edwards, PeopleSoft, and Oracle Fusion Cloud Applications. These solutions help customers understand how their operations actually run, accelerate and de-risk modernization to Oracle Fusion Cloud, and provide the operational context needed to scale Enterprise AI. The team combines hands-on technical depth, customer focus, and a product mindset to create repeatable offerings that can be adopted across the Oracle customer base.

The Role:

We're looking for a hybrid between a product manager and an engineer: someone who can sit with an Oracle customer, understand a process or modernization challenge, and then design and build the solution with the rest of the team rather than handing it off. Afterwards, you extract the knowledge from your deployments and feed them back into the Celonis knowledge layer, ensuring scalability for future deployments. You'll operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where shipping quickly matters more than perfect process and where the line between designing and building the product is intentionally blurry. You will get hands-on with Oracle data, process models, applications, and AI-driven workflows on the Celonis platform, iterating directly with the customers and partners who will use them.

You'll be at the center of the Celonis and Oracle partnership, turning joint go-to-market priorities into working products that accelerate Oracle modernization and deliver measurable customer value. If you're energized by owning an Oracle-focused solution portfolio end-to-end, moving fast, and being measured by adoption and impact, this is for you.

The work you'll do:

Your mission is to build the Oracle-focused solution portfolio that turns the Celonis and Oracle partnership strategy into repeatable products customers can deploy. You will combine Celonis Process Intelligence and the Celonis Context Model with Oracle application and process expertise to help customers modernize with confidence and scale Enterprise AI with trusted operational context.

- Own the roadmap and ship purpose-built, reusable solutions for Oracle source systems and pain points

- Build solutions that help customers discover process complexity, identify high-risk customizations, benchmark performance, and create data-driven modernization roadmaps for Oracle Fusion Cloud

- Use Celonis Process Intelligence and the Celonis Context Model to create operational context for finance, supply chain, and other core processes, including Oracle AI agents and AI services running on OCI

- Leverage frontier AI development tools that plug natively into the platform, using them to accelerate how you build, enrich, deploy solutions and extract knowledge for future reference

- Work hands-on across Oracle data connections, extraction and transformation logic, object-centric process models, analyses, applications, and AI capabilities to deliver production-ready solutions

- Move fluidly between customer discovery, prototype, and production: validate the Oracle-specific pain point, build the solution, put it in front of users, measure value, and iterate quickly

- Partner with Oracle and Celonis product, engineering, alliances, sales, and solution teams to translate joint go-to-market priorities into differentiated offerings, demos, enablement, and customer outcomes

- Collaborate with customers and implementation partners to ensure solutions work across Oracle applications, third-party applications, and custom solutions on OCI, and scale across the joint customer base

If you are passionate about driving AI transformation for some of the largest group of customers in the world, this is your chance to shape a strategic solution portfolio and help make the Celonis and Oracle partnership successful in the market.

The qualifications you need:

- 5 - 7 years of experience as a product engineer, technical product manager, functional consultant, solution architect, founding/forward-deployed engineer, or comparable hybrid builder role

- A track record of building coherent, repeatable product offerings for enterprise applications, not just isolated features; you think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together

- Technical and tech-savvy: comfortable with enterprise data and integration concepts (SQL, PQL, Python, APIs, MCP, and agents), able to prototype and build, and quick to pick up new tools and platforms

- Demonstrated functional and technical knowledge of Oracle application landscapes, especially Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Fusion Cloud and / or PeopleSoft Applications; JD Edwards is a plus

- Demonstrated knowledge of Oracle modernization, including assessing legacy processes and customizations, defining a transformation roadmap, and reducing migration risk on the path to Oracle Fusion Cloud

- Knowledge of finance, supply chain, or other end-to-end enterprise processes, plus the architectures, data models, and integrations that support them

- Experience working with technology alliances, sales and solution engineering teams, or implementation partners to bring joint offerings to market is a strong plus

- Excellent communication skills and the willingness to work closely with customers, Oracle stakeholders, partners, and cross-functional Celonis teams

- Very good knowledge of spoken and written English (German is a plus)

jobs.description:

The Team:

The Celonis Business Apps Supply Chain team is an innovative group of product and technology enthusiasts focused on creating and deploying next-generation solutions in the Supply Chain domain. We are transforming how enterprise solutions are built driven by our customers' business critical problems. Our team strikes an ideal balance between deep technical execution (including advanced data engineering and AI tooling) and a sharp customer focus to create highly impactful products that accelerate value realization across our customer base.

The Role:

You will gain experience in the Supply Chain and related processes and act as the interface between customers, our Go-To-Market and our Product & Engineering teams, shaping the future of Celonis’ product offering in this domain. Take this chance to rethink the way companies run their Supply Chain processes, with a specific focus on Procurement and help our customers to accelerate their value realization with Celonis.

As an Application Product Manager for Procurement, you will operate at the intersection of customer-facing solution engineering and core product innovation to architect and deploy cutting-edge enterprise AI solutions. In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do:

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis  Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

- Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.

- Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.

- Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.

- Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.

- Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level.

The qualifications you need:

- 4+ years of experience as a Solution Engineer, Product Engineer, Technical Product Manager, Founding/Forward-Deployed Engineer, Implementation Consultant or a comparable technical, customer-facing role hybrid role.

- Comprehensive knowledge of core operational workflows in supply chain and procurement. You can speak the language of C-suite executives and seamlessly connect complex, systemic bottlenecks to strategic AI solutions.

- A track record of building coherent solutions, not just isolated features. You think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together.

- Expert in data analysis and data modeling including tools native to the Celonis platform: SQL, Python, quick to pick up new tools and platforms and able to prototype and build. Experience with platform-native tools like PQL is a significant asset.

- Advanced architectural mastery of LLM orchestration, tool use/function calling, RAG, agents, prompt engineering, and agentic patterns for enterprise workflows.

- Hands-on exposure to enterprise architectures, with ERP systems (such as SAP or Oracle) or Material Requirements Planning (MRP) logic considered a strong plus.

- Demonstrated project management capabilities accompanied by excellent planning and organizational skills.

- Creativity in problem-solving, a solution-oriented mindset, and the ability to work autonomously while collaborating smoothly across multi-disciplinary squads.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the willingness to work very closely with customers and cross-functional stakeholders.

- Fluency in spoken and written English (knowledge of German is a plus).

In this hybrid role, you will partner directly with strategic customers to build bespoke, composable procurement and supply chain architectures using the Celonis Context Model (CCM) and advanced decision intelligence. By leveraging modern AI tooling and LLM-based coding agents, you will abstract field insights into reusable semantic libraries, directly accelerating Celonis' global agentic deployment workflows. You get hands-on: prototyping on the platform, wiring up data, building AI-driven solutions, and iterating directly with the people who'll use them.

The work you’ll do:

Your mission is to make the vision of AI-powered solutions a reality by building products that turn the cutting edge capabilities of the Celonis  Platform from strategy into solutions that customers use to run their Procurement processes.

- Discovery & Solution Blueprinting: Conduct collaborative discovery workshops to uncover root-causes and operational inefficiencies, mapping ambiguous customer needs into clear technical scopes and comprehensive solution blueprints.

- Context Model & Solution Deployment: Execute hands-on deployments of customer-specific context models, data structures, and end-to-end supply chain blueprints within the Celonis platform.

- Project Management & Customer Value: Own customer deployments end-to-end from initial kickoff to live production, presenting complex architectural solutions and strategic value narratives directly to cross-functional stakeholders and executive teams.

- Prototype & Test Functions: Design, validate, and test use-case-specific decision intelligence functions, including e.g. optimization algorithms and predictive models.

- Context Generation: Deconstruct monolithic application architectures and translate deployment learnings into reusable semantic entities and modular context libraries.

If you are passionate about Procurement, Supply Chain, the Celonis technology, and what it can do for our customers, here's your chance to directly contribute to taking our Celonis Platform and Context Model to the next level.

The qualifications you need:

- A track record of building coherent solutions, not just isolated features. You think in terms of the whole solution and how the pieces fit together.
